verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers free public tools, including the Document Driver®, a free generator for Delaware C-Corp, multi-member LLC and single-member LLC formation documents. That covers the incorporation part of the story. The SAFE material is only an explanatory guide, and the other free tools are dilution and liquidation calculators, not document templates. Missing for 10: a downloadable or generated SAFE or term sheet template, an NDA form, and explicit confirmation of no-account, non-client access.
